_doc: Curated image gallery of the app. Every image was chosen by hand after checking its NASA description (place shown, not an artist's rendering). kind: rover | lander | apollo | orbital | visualization (Moon/Mars); field | astronaut | satellite | radar (Earth). Keys: Moon/Mars target ids (homologue ids in web/src/data/sites.ts), Earth catalog site ids, and region:<region> for the discoveries of the global search. Built by src/export_gallery.py. See docs/DATOS_WEB.md.
